sloka: श्रुत्वा सगर्वितम् वाक्यम् संभ्रान्ता जनकात्मजा ।सीता प्रावेपिता उद्वेगात् प्रवाते कदली यथा ॥३-२-१५॥
transliteration: śrutvā sagarvitam vākyam saṁbhrāntā janakātmajā ।sītā prāvepitā udvegāt pravāte kadalī yathā ॥3-2-15॥

translations.english: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:
